**Need:** the image, audio and theme files the Snake game loads, delivered under `assets/` in your repository (I expect the work assignment to give you the `assets/` path; I will not put files there).

**Spec** (game-developer commit 3cd506d, `docs/assets.md`):
- Images (PNG, transparent unless stated), grid cell 32x32 px, 20x20 grid:
  - `assets/images/snake_head.png` 32x32, head facing **right** (game rotates it)
  - `assets/images/snake_body.png` 32x32, horizontal straight segment, tiles seamlessly with head/tail
  - `assets/images/snake_tail.png` 32x32, tail pointing **left**
  - `assets/images/food.png` 32x32, ~24 px visible, centred
  - `assets/images/tile.png` 32x32, **opaque** low-contrast floor tile

issue.author: qa
issue.body:
Found on assembled delivery game-developer 6a0a8539da44 + artist bcf60b1e443a (also cb21dad). Requirements: R8 (score visible during play), R2 (board visible).

Steps: serve the delivery, open index.html in a Chromium viewport of 1366x650 (typical 1366x768 laptop with browser chrome), press Enter.
Expected: HUD (Score/Best) and the whole 20x20 board are visible.
Actual: #game is a fixed ~674 px tall (HUD + 640 px board) in a body with display:flex; align-items:center; height:100%, so it overflows both ends and the top is unreachable by scrolling. Measured #game top/bottom: 1366x650 -> -12/662 (Score row half cut, board bottom row cut); 1024x600 and 800x600 -> -37/637 (Score/Best hidden entirely). Fits at 1366x768, 1280x720, 1440x700.
Suggested fix: size the board to the viewport, e.g. #game width: min(640px, 96vw, calc((100vh - 60px))) (keep aspect), or use justify/align safe centering plus scaling.
Evidence: world/qa repo evidence/build-1/07-1366x650-playing.png, 07-1024x600-playing.png, results.json; reproduce with tests/qa_check.py <delivery> <outdir>. Everything else in R1-R10 passed (reports/build-1.md).

issue.author: producer
issue.body:
Finding from acceptance of build 2 (assembled delivery game-developer 6a0a8539da44b90751680567680e423fade39de3 + artist bcf60b1e443a15d5ee974c0063b9fe5b50216096), reported by playtester on build 1 (playtester `reports/build-1.md` at 80161ea, captures 1024x600 and 800x500) and reproduced by me on build 2.

**Must fix — R8 "the score during play" (and R2 board visible) fail on short windows.** The board is a fixed 640 px canvas centred in the viewport; when the window is shorter than ~720 px the HUD and the board's edges are pushed outside the viewport *above the top*, where the page cannot scroll to them. Measured on build 2 in Chromium after pressing Enter (`getBoundingClientRect`, scrollY):
- 1024x600: HUD top −37 / bottom −3, board top −3 / bottom 637, scrollY 0 → score not visible, bottom row cut off.
- 800x500: HUD top −87, board bottom 587 → same, worse.
- 1366x768: HUD 47–81, board 81–721 → fine.
Captures: producer `acceptance/build2/vp-1024x600.png`, `vp-800x500.png`, `vp-1366x768.png`.
Standard to meet: at any viewport from 800x500 up, the whole board, the score during play and the title/game-over screens (incl. Play again button) are fully visible without scrolling (e.g. scale the board to fit the viewport, keeping the grid crisp), with no change to the rules.

**Should fix (playtester, mild):**
- Game-over overlay dims the board so much the player can't see what they hit; lighten it so the final board stays readable behind the final score.
- After the window loses focus the game auto-pauses and only P/Esc resume; also let Enter/Space (or a click on the board) resume, or say on the pause screen which keys do.

Please publish the fixed build as a new release and answer here; I'll hand it to playtester and qa.

HUTIAN_REVIEW_DECISION: {"conclusion":"Build 2 meets the rules R2-R7, R9, R10 in my play, but the score HUD and board edges leave the viewport (unscrollably) on windows under ~720 px tall, failing R8 on common laptop screens; fix layout to fit 800x500 and up, plus two mild playtest polish items.","disposition":"revise","evidence":["producer acceptance/build2/vp-1024x600.png: HUD top -37px, board bottom 637px in 600px viewport, scrollY 0","producer acceptance/build2/vp-800x500.png","playtester reports/build-1.md at 80161ea422f76dacfe716a85ed0c3109e6fdd83c item 1"]}
issue.title: Score HUD and board leave the window on screens under ~720 px tall (build 2)

comments.author: game-developer
comments.body:
Fixed in release **v0.3.0** (`snake-v0.3.0.zip`), assembled delivery game-developer `dcc9ebb6d219d8ec76f7a3cc4a4988cb182621b1` + artist `bcf60b1e443a15d5ee974c0063b9fe5b50216096`.

- **Must fix (R8/R2 on short windows):** the board now scales to fit the window (`src/style.css`: board = min(640 px, 96vw, viewport height − HUD)), and all screen text and buttons scale with it. Rules unchanged. `tests/check.py` measures getBoundingClientRect against the viewport, checks no screen overflows and the page doesn't scroll, on the title, play and game-over screens. It passes at 800x500, 1024x600, 1280x720, 1366x768, 1920x1080 and 500x800. Captures: `tests/out/vp-800x500-{title,playing,gameover}.png` and the same for the other sizes.
- **Game-over readability:** overlay dim reduced from 62% to 22%, with the result in a bordered panel, so the final board (snake, food, where it hit) stays visible (`tests/out/vp-800x500-gameover.png`).
- **Resume after auto-pause:** P, Esc, Enter, Space or a click on the pause screen resume, and the pause screen says so (checked: all three paths resume, the snake doesn't move while paused).

Whole suite on exactly this assembled delivery: 34/34, zero console errors. Closing; reopen if anything still falls short.

- R4 met: +1 length and +1 score per food; food placed only on free cells.
- R5 met: all four walls end the game, no wrap. R6 met: head into body ends the game.
